gate_evidence: real `factory gate` run at this head in a throwaway --shared clone with refs/remotes/origin/main set to review_base; only a [repo].slug line was prepended to .factory.toml for slug resolution, committed gate checks unmodified

findings.obligation: issue #20 Scope: ship a `conflict` default profile that resolves the rebase; the same commit's FIX path re-gates, pushes and re-reviews the kept `agent/<n>` worktree
findings.defect: The FIX round pushes with `dispatch.run(['git','push','origin',f'agent/{n}'], cwd=wt)`. `dispatch.run` defaults to `check=True`, so when the shipped `conflict` worker resolves/restarts the rebase — rewriting `agent/<n>` — the push is a non-fast-forward, git exits nonzero and `apply()` raises `CalledProcessError` after a PASSING gate: the fix is never pushed, the PR is never updated, no re-review happens and no escalation is recorded.
evidence: factory/templates/factory.toml:+# [workers.conflict] … "Resolve the rebase conflicts … If the rebase was aborted, restart it against the configured main before resolving."
factory/manage.py:+Dispatch exactly one round of that listed worker in the kept agent worktree for its open PR.
findings.rationale: The profile the ticket requires to ship cannot complete through the FIX path added in the same diff. Corroboration (not oracle): follow-up ce5568e changes exactly this line to `--force-with-lease` and adds a rebase case to the FIX test.

unnecessary_demand_rule: Any finding beyond D1 that does not cite a README/docs convention or an issue #20 acceptance criterion.
adjudication: independent read of the frozen source by the calibration owner; historical model verdicts were used only to discover candidates, never as truth
